candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) in the inventory service, causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order to fail with ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics or logs admitted; underlying cause of the Redis timeouts (saturation, network, config) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out with DependencyUnavailable across multiple correlation IDs, propagating 503 from inventory and ReadTimeout at order, yielding gateway 502s on /v1/checkout. Metrics confirm 16 502s and p95 ~2425ms on /v1/checkout. Topology links inventory to redis. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/saturation metrics to confirm the timeout origin
Inventory service logs for the reserve_inventory failures
